questions.stem: A shopkeeper sold an item for ₹900.00 at a loss of 25%. What should have been the sale price of the item if he had wished to sell it at a profit of 10%?
questions.explanation: CP = 900 / 0.75 = 1200. SP for 10% profit = 1200 * 1.10 = 1320? Wait, 1200 * 1.10 = 1320. Let's check option A. CP = 900 / (1 - 0.25) = 900 / 0.75 = 1200. Then 10% profit on 1200 is 1200 * 1.10 = 1320. Hence option A is correct.
questions.subject: General Studies
